fee_notes: Royalty is tiered for first 12 months (conversion: 3%/2.5%/2%, standard: 6%/5%/4% on tiers of revenue), then 6% with $1,500 monthly minimum thereafter. Brand Fund 2% ongoing with $450 minimum (month 13+). Technology fee $399/month subject to max 15% annual increase. Additional fees: digital marketing $299-$499/month, local advertising up to 2% gross revenue, per-user accounts $10-$25/month, plus miscellaneous operational fees.
